title: Bisect canonical CSR rows for point lookup
finding: TypedRelationBlock.get() already resolves row and column labels against canonical sorted axes and every CSR row is required to retain strictly increasing column indices, but point lookup still linearly scanned the selected stored row until equality or the first larger column. This repeated work over an ordering invariant the block already owns.
primary_claim: TypedRelationBlock.get() now uses bisect_left directly inside the selected canonical CSR row. Unknown labels still fail closed, absent stored coordinates still return the canonical semiring zero, and Fourfold subject identity, typed axes, CSR wire format and semiring semantics remain unchanged.
gardener_decision: Reuse the canonical CSR row ordering already enforced by TypedRelationBlock and the existing bisect dependency instead of adding another lookup index, cache, service, sparse representation or planner.
acceptance: point lookup searches only the selected canonical CSR row with bisect_left
